* '''Mission''': [[File:GTA San Andreas radar School.png]][[Grand Theft Auto: San Andreas/Learning to Fly|Learning to Fly]]
* '''Location''': [[File:GTA San Andreas radar Triads Casino.png]]Four Dragon's Casino, Las Venturas
|}

The objective is to scare the guy tied to the hood of your car into talking. Don't hit anything head on - you don't
need him dead. Drive on the wrong side of the road, really fast with some hand brake turns thrown in for good measure. Once his "Scare Meter" is full, he will talk.

==Rewards ==
* '''Cash''': $5,000
* Respect +

==Tips ==
* Remember: you don't want to kill him — just scare him with your crazy driving (avoid crashes).
* If you have a valid pilot license take him to the airport and drive full speed there, without worrying about cops or pedestrians/other vehicles.
* Stay off the freeway or highway.
